services.desc: Marine Wildlife - Jet Ski Adventure Duration 4 Hours About Get ready for a truly once-in-a-lifetime Alaskan experience! Our exciting jet ski tours are half-day adventures that take you through Resurrection Bay. While experiencing Alaska by jet ski, you will be safely guided by a knowledgeable and experienced guide. On our tours, you will travel along the breathtaking landscape. You will have an opportunity to whale watch and view wildlife in this extremely unique way. Whether you are an experienced jet skier or new to the sport, we can help you feel comfortable on the seas!
